title: Julia Stiles reveals why she wanted to honour Heath Ledger    authentically    on    Dancing with the Stars
description: Stiles said the duo felt a responsibility to approach the performance with sensitivity and respect for Ledger s memory
content:
Stiles said the duo felt a responsibility to approach the performance with sensitivity and respect for Ledger's memory
Julia Stiles has explained why she wanted to honour her late 10 Things I Hate About You co-star Heath Ledger with an authentic and heartfelt performance on Dancing with the Stars, revealing the care she and professional dance partner Ezra Sosa took when creating the emotional tribute.
Speaking exclusively to People after the show's Dedication Night on Tuesday, October 20, Stiles said the pair felt a responsibility to approach the performance with sensitivity and respect for Ledger's memory.
“I think we both felt a responsibility to be respectful, to honor him in a way that felt authentic and sincere. And we wanted to handle it delicately,” the actress said.
Stiles, 45, and Sosa, 25, performed a contemporary routine to Frankie Valli's Can't Take My Eyes Off You, the song Ledger famously sang to Stiles' character, Kat Stratford, in the 1999 romantic comedy. Their performance incorporated references to the original film, including a blue dress reminiscent of the one Stiles wore in the movie, and ended with the actress approaching a photograph of herself and Ledger on screen.
Sosa suggested opening the routine with a more sombre, acoustic arrangement before building towards the song's brass section. Stiles agreed that the performance needed to capture the energy of Ledger's memorable serenade, describing his presence in the scene as captivating.
The tribute also brought together several of the film's cast members, including Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Gabrielle Union, Andrew Keegan, Susan May Pratt and Larisa Oleynik. They joined Stiles at the end of the performance, creating an emotional reunion in honour of their late co-star.
Reflecting on their time filming 10 Things I Hate About You, Stiles told People that the cast had been close and enjoyed working together. She recalled how open-hearted they were at the time, describing Ledger as the most playful member of the group who made everyone feel comfortable putting their hearts into the film.
Stiles had also spoken about the emotional impact of revisiting the movie during rehearsals, admitting she had underestimated how strongly the memories would affect her. Watching old clips, seeing photographs and hearing the cast's voices again brought back feelings she had not expected to experience so intensely.
Ledger died in January 2008 at the age of 28 from an accidental prescription drug overdose. His performance as Patrick Verona in 10 Things I Hate About You remains one of his most recognisable roles, particularly the scene in which he serenades Kat from the school bleachers.
For Stiles and Sosa, the tribute was an opportunity to celebrate both Ledger's legacy and a film that continues to resonate with audiences decades after its release.

Julia Roberts is set to star in a film adaptation of Home Economics, the forthcoming novel by bestselling author Katy Hays, with People exclusively revealing the book’s cover and details of its story.
The Oscar-winning actress is also attached to produce the adaptation through her production company, Red Om Films, alongside Lisa Roberts Gillan and Marisa Yeres Gill. Marc Platt will also produce through Marc Platt Productions, while Hays is set to adapt her novel for the screen and executive produce the project.
The novel, scheduled for release on May 4, 2027, follows Punch Tillis, a once-celebrated homemaking icon whose empire collapses, costing her brand, marriage and beloved Brieskill Farm in New York’s Hudson Valley. After years away, Punch returns to her former home while working as a caterer and unexpectedly finds herself drawn back into the property’s orbit.
Inspired by a local college student, Punch decides to reclaim her former home by squatting there. Her actions attract national attention, setting the stage for a darkly humorous story about ambition, personal reinvention and the meaning of home.
Hays has drawn inspiration from her own family’s connection to a historic farmhouse, informing the novel’s exploration of the emotional ties people develop to their homes and what happens when those connections are threatened.
The film adaptation was acquired by Sony’s 3000 Pictures following competitive interest in the upcoming book. Hays previously attracted attention with her debut novel, The Cloisters, and her subsequent novel, Saltwater.
Roberts continues to expand her slate of projects across film and production. The actress recently starred in Luca Guadagnino’s After the Hunt and is also attached to the upcoming thriller Panic Carefully, directed by Sam Esmail.

Williams did not share further details about the film, with his team declining to elaborate when asked
Heated Rivalry star Hudson Williams is writing a new film featuring an ex-hockey player, but the actor has admitted that his work on the hit hockey romance series has made him question whether to keep the character in the script.
Williams revealed the project during an interview with Entertainment Weekly alongside his Yaga co-star Carrie-Anne Moss. The actor explained that he and his collaborators had considered changing the character’s sporting background to avoid similarities with Heated Rivalry, in which he plays professional hockey player Shane Hollander.
“I’m writing a movie right now, but one character is an ex-hockey player,” Williams said. “We were like, ‘But if we have this hockey player and then you’ve done a hockey show…’ We’re getting tripped up on it and we’re considering other sports, but for some reason this character just made way more sense being an ex-hockey player.”
He added that the creative process had made him reflect on the limits artists can place on themselves, saying, “It’s almost like you have to bust through the prison of your own mind or construct of your own mind.”
Williams did not share further details about the film, with his team declining to elaborate when asked about the project.
Before gaining international recognition through Heated Rivalry, Williams wrote and directed several short films, including Soakers, Buttons and Inside Augustine Mendoza’s Quotidian Apartment. His latest project marks another opportunity for the actor to develop his work behind the camera while continuing to build his acting career.
Williams is also preparing for the next chapter of Heated Rivalry, with production on its second season continuing in Canada. The series, adapted from Rachel Reid’s Game Changers novels, follows the complicated relationship between rival hockey players Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov, played by Connor Storrie.
The actor will next appear in Yaga, a detective thriller that reimagines the Slavic folklore figure Baba Yaga in a contemporary setting. title: PHC stays arrest of K P Assembly deputy speaker  orders de sealing of official residence
description: Bench seeks replies from chief secretary  IGP on Suraiya Bibi s petition  action termed politically motivated
content:
Bench seeks replies from chief secretary, IGP on Suraiya Bibi's petition
The Peshawar High Court (PHC) on Wednesday restrained the police from arresting Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa Assembly Deputy Speaker Suraiya Bibi under the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) Ordinance and suspended the administration’s notification sealing her official residence.
A two-member bench comprising Justice Ijaz Anwar and Justice Muhammad Fahim Wali heard the writ petition filed by the deputy speaker through her counsel, Advocate Yasar Khattak. The court issued notices to the chief secretary, inspector general of police and other relevant authorities, directing them to submit their replies by the next date of hearing.
Counsel for the petitioner told the court that Suraiya Bibi was allotted the official residence in 2024 in her capacity as deputy speaker. Following the imposition of emergency and Governor’s Rule in the province on October 11, police raided her residence on October 14 and sealed the premises, an action he described as illegal.
Read : K-P speaker, deputy set for enhanced privileges
Khattak argued that even under emergency and Governor’s Rule, the official residence of the deputy speaker could not be sealed without fulfilling legal requirements. He sought orders restraining her arrest under 3-MPO and directing the authorities to de-seal the residence, contending that the moves amounted to political victimisation.
The lawyer further submitted that both the speaker and deputy speaker continue to hold their constitutional offices under the law until a new assembly is formed, and any such action against them is ultra vires the Constitution and the law.
After hearing the arguments, the bench stayed Suraiya Bibi’s arrest under 3-MPO and suspended the notification sealing her official residence pending further proceedings.

content:
Waqar, Taimur smash centuries as PTV fight back against MIT Solutions
Imam-ul-Haq struck an unbeaten double century for Oil and Gas Development Company Limited (OGDCL) on the third day of the seventh-round President’s Trophy Grade-I match on Wednesday, while Waqar Hussain and Taimur Khan scored centuries to lead Pakistan Television (PTV) in a remarkable recovery.
At Lahore’s LCCA Ground, Imam resumed on 118 not out and advanced to 200 not out, helping OGDCL declare their first innings at 410 for nine to take a 178-run lead over Ghani Glass. His innings included 19 fours and two sixes.
Saad Khan contributed 88, while Ali Zaryab made 42. Ubaid Shah led Ghani’s bowling attack with five wickets for 131 runs.
Ghani, who were dismissed for 232 in their first innings, reached 82 for three in their second innings at stumps, with Hashim Ibrahim and Sharjeel Khan scoring 34 each. They trail by 96 runs.
At the Shoaib Akhtar Cricket Stadium in Rawalpindi, Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited (SNGPL) moved to 87 for four in pursuit of a 191-run target against Khan Research Laboratories (KRL), leaving them 104 runs short of victory.
Mohammad Rizwan was unbeaten on 22 at the close after KRL were dismissed for 234 in their second innings. Mohammad Faiq, who resumed on 64 not out, added only two runs before departing for 66.
Shehzad Gul took five wickets for 61 runs while Shahnawaz Dahani claimed three for 66 to help restrict KRL. SNGPL had been dismissed for 195 in their first innings, with Rizwan scoring 64.
At the Diamond Cricket Ground in Islamabad, PTV produced a spirited response against MIT Solutions after being bowled out for just 64 in their first innings.
Following on against MIT’s 412, PTV were dismissed for 394 in their second innings, with Waqar Hussain scoring 171 and Taimur Khan making 151. The pair converted their overnight scores of 102 not out and 63 not out respectively into commanding centuries.
Khalid Usman took four wickets for 90 runs, while Salman Aslam and Mohammad Ismail claimed three wickets apiece as MIT secured a first-innings lead and were left with a target of 47 runs.

The news was acknowledged by a spokesperson for Stick Run, who released a statement addressing the video and said Otto appeared to have died by suicide. The circumstances surrounding his death have not been fully confirmed, according to TMZ , which reported the news on October 21.
The Stick Run spokesperson also requested privacy for everyone affected by the tragedy and urged people not to spread unverified rumours online.
Details about the location of Otto’s death remain unclear. Reports have suggested a possible connection to an incident involving a fatal fire in Bavaria, Germany, although the circumstances have not been independently confirmed.
Otto was widely recognised for developing Stick Run when he was just 14. The multiplayer game gained popularity among players, helping establish his name in online gaming and internet culture.
Following news of his death, fans took to social media to share condolences and pay tribute to the German influencer. His death has prompted an outpouring of messages from people who remembered his contribution to online gaming.
At the time of reporting, further details about the incident and any official findings had not been made public.
Otto’s death comes amid renewed attention to the pressures and risks associated with online platforms, where livestreams can expose private moments to large audiences. However, no information has established a connection between those broader concerns and the circumstances of his death.

title: Billie Eilish and FINNEAS launch new jewellery collections with John Hardy
description: The collections  named Wildflower and Screwball  were developed alongside John Hardy creative chairman Reed Krakoff
content:
The collections, named Wildflower and Screwball, were developed alongside John Hardy creative chairman Reed Krakoff
Billie Eilish and her brother, FINNEAS, are expanding their creative partnership beyond music with two new jewellery collections designed in collaboration with luxury brand John Hardy, combining their personal styles with a shared commitment to sustainability.
Launched on October 21, the collections, named Wildflower and Screwball, were developed alongside John Hardy creative chairman Reed Krakoff. The collaboration builds on the siblings’ existing relationship with the brand, which began when they became its first celebrity ambassadors around a year ago. The new lines give Eilish and FINNEAS a more direct role in designing jewellery that reflects their individual aesthetics.
The Wildflower collection takes inspiration from Eilish’s 2024 song of the same name, featuring delicate floral motifs across rings, earrings, bracelets and pendant necklaces. Crafted from sterling silver and lab-grown diamonds, the designs reflect the softer, more romantic side of the singer’s style.
In contrast, Screwball embraces a bolder, more industrial aesthetic, with minimalist designs intended to complement streetwear and layered jewellery looks. The two collections are designed to work together, bringing contrasting elements of softness and strength into a single wardrobe.
Eilish said jewellery has long been an important part of how she expresses herself, describing it as a reflection of different periods in her life. She explained that her everyday style tends towards more delicate pieces, while she prefers chunkier jewellery when performing on tour.
“I love that we were able to work with both styles,” the singer said.
FINNEAS also spoke about how his taste has evolved alongside his sister’s, explaining that they have become more minimalist as they have grown older. He said he increasingly appreciates simple silhouettes and understated designs.
The collection reflects the siblings’ ability to translate their creative instincts into a product beyond their usual work in music, where they have collaborated on songwriting and production for much of Eilish’s career.
Sustainability is another central element of the partnership. The pieces are made using more than 99% reclaimed sterling silver alongside lab-grown diamonds, reflecting both the siblings’ environmental advocacy and John Hardy’s emphasis on responsible materials.
The collections are priced between $195 and $2,400, making them more accessible than some of the brand’s higher-priced jewellery offerings. They are available through John Hardy’s online store and selected retailers, including Nordstrom.
For John Hardy, the launch represents a significant expansion of its celebrity collaborations. Company president Matt Tepper described Eilish and FINNEAS as a strong fit for the brand because of their outspoken support for sustainability, a principle rooted in the company's founding philosophy.
The campaign accompanying the launch features the siblings in imagery shot on Super 8 film, reinforcing the collections’ blend of personal expression, artistry and craftsmanship. Both artists are also expected to promote the jewellery through their social media platforms.
The new collections further extend Eilish and FINNEAS’s influence beyond the music industry, demonstrating how their shared creative identity can translate into fashion and design while maintaining a focus on sustainability.

title: Taylor Swift calls performing with her band again after nearly two years a    VIBE
description: Swift performed a four song set singing  Blank Space    The Fate of Ophelia    I Knew It  I Knew You  and  Love Story
content:
Swift performed a four-song set singing 'Blank Space', 'The Fate of Ophelia', 'I Knew It, I Knew You' and 'Love Story'
Taylor Swift is reflecting on her return to the stage with her longtime band, describing the experience as a “VIBE” after performing live with them for the first time in almost two years at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles.
The 14-time Grammy winner took to Instagram on October 20 to share photos from the star-studded event, which took place on October 17. “A night at the museum I'll never forget! Thank you to the @academymuseum for inviting us,” Swift wrote alongside the pictures, which included moments from the evening and her appearance in a custom ice-blue Dior gown.
“Getting to perform with the band again for the first time in almost 2 years was a VIBE,” the singer added, expressing her excitement about reuniting with the musicians who accompanied her throughout her record-breaking Eras Tour.
Swift performed a four-song set to close the gala, opening with “Blank Space” before singing “The Fate of Ophelia”, “I Knew It, I Knew You” and “Love Story”. The performance marked the first time she had performed a full set with her band since the conclusion of the Eras Tour in December 2024.
The evening also featured a significant milestone for Swift's music. She performed “The Fate of Ophelia” live for the first time, giving fans their first opportunity to hear the song performed onstage. She also sang “I Knew It, I Knew You”, her contribution to Toy Story 5, with a full band rather than as part of a mashup.
Swift's Instagram post also included a photograph with Joan Cusack, who voices Jessie in Toy Story 5. The singer previously revealed that the beloved animated character inspired her to write “I Knew It, I Knew You” after watching an early version of the film.
The track reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and US country radio charts, marking Swift's first No. 1 on country radio in 13 years.
Conan O'Brien introduced Swift before her performance, jokingly referring to her as a member of the Toy Story 5 family. During the set, the singer encouraged the formally dressed audience to join in, telling guests that dancing was allowed and would make the evening more fun.
The sixth annual Academy Museum Gala honoured filmmaker and composer John Carpenter, actor Colman Domingo and actress Charlize Theron for their contributions to cinema. The event raised more than $14 million to support the museum's exhibitions, educational initiatives and public programming.
Swift's appearance also brought together several of Hollywood's biggest names, with guests including Sabrina Carpenter, Connor Storrie, Andrew Garfield, Demi Moore, Jacob Elordi and Kim Kardashian.
For Swift, the evening offered an opportunity to celebrate her connection to cinema while returning to the live performances that defined much of her recent career. Her enthusiastic reaction to reuniting with her band suggests that, even after the extraordinary scale of the Eras Tour, performing together remains a special experience.

title: Gulf states hold extraordinary meeting in Riyadh to boost military coordination  readiness
description: Meeting comes amid escalating attacks by Houthis on Saudi Arabia and Gulf and international efforts to halt them
content:
Meeting comes amid escalating attacks by Houthis on Saudi Arabia and Gulf and international efforts to halt them
Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states held an extraordinary meeting in Riyadh on Wednesday to discuss strengthening cooperation and coordination among their armed forces amid continued attacks by Yemen’s Houthi group on Saudi Arabia.
The meeting was held by the GCC Armed Forces Operations and Training Committee, according to a statement from the UAE Defence Ministry.
The GCC comprises Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman.
Read : UAE adviser Gargash urges need to revive joint ties on Gulf security, defence
The ministry said the extraordinary meeting took place at the headquarters of the GCC General Secretariat but did not disclose the names of the participants.
It said the meeting discussed “several issues aimed at strengthening joint military cooperation in operations and training”, as well as “developing coordination and integration mechanisms” among Gulf armed forces.
The discussions also sought to “support joint Gulf defence efforts and enhance military readiness and efficiency in the fields of operations and training”, the ministry said .
The statement did not detail any decisions made at the meeting or directly mention discussions on Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia.
The meeting comes amid escalating attacks by Yemen’s Houthi group on Saudi Arabia and Gulf and international efforts to halt them.
Read More : Houthis claim ballistic missile strike on Riyadh airport
The GCC has not issued a statement on the meeting so far. However, its Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi called on Sunday for “effective” international action against the Houthi group at the conclusion of a ministerial meeting in Manama.
Yemen has seen a military escalation since July between government forces backed by the Saudi-led coalition and the Houthis, following a period of relative calm associated with a truce that began in April 2022.
The conflict in Yemen began after the Houthis seized the capital Sanaa and several provinces in September 2014.

title: PTI dismisses reports of internal rifts as Dogar signals possible resumption of talks with government
description: Gandapur and Raja exchange barbs on social media
content:
Gandapur and Raja exchange barbs on social media
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Chief Whip Malik Aamir Dogar said talks with the government could resume in the coming days as the party on Wednesday dismissed reports of internal divisions over the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) chief ministership, party leadership and fears of a possible forward bloc.
A day earlier, Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said a ban on the PTI was no longer necessary after the imposition of governor’s rule in K-P. The government and opposition failed to reach an agreement, and the emergency and governor’s rule were declared on October 11 after negotiations failed , following a PTI long march towards Islamabad that began on October 4. Last week, a joint session of parliament adopted two separate resolutions ratifying the presidential proclamations imposing a state of emergency and governor’s rule in K-P for two months, amid protests from the opposition. Before that, both houses of parliament had separately approved the emergency in the province by majority vote under Clause 1 of Article 232 of the Constitution, despite objections from opposition lawmakers.
Speaking exclusively to The Express Tribune , Dogar rejected reports of internal divisions, saying there were no differences within the parliamentary party.
He expressed full confidence in opposition leaders Mahmood Khan Achakzai and Allama Raja Nasir Abbas, saying they had been entrusted with responsibilities by the party’s founding chairman and that party members were expected to support them.
On the possibility of changing the opposition leader, Dogar said no such decision could be taken without the founding chairman’s approval.
Read : PHC seeks Centre’s response over imposition of emergency, governor’s rule in K-P
Addressing the speculations around the office of the chief minister in K-P, he maintained that Sohail Afridi remained the province’s constitutional and lawful chief minister and continued to hold the office with the confidence of the founding chairman.
“No one else can become chief minister without the founding chairman’s consent,” he said, warning that any attempt to replace Afridi sans approval would amount to stabbing the party in the back. He insisted that Afridi would remain the chief minister, while alleging that certain elements were seeking to deepen divisions within the party.
Criticising the prevailing political climate, the PTI chief whip said, “Fascism is at its peak,” adding that PTI was facing “unprecedented repression”. He claimed that more than 10 of the party’s MNAs were in jail.
He further underscored that PTI believed in dialogue and expressed hope that negotiations with the government would resume in the coming days.
The reported emergence of an audio recording allegedly featuring former K-P chief minister Ali Amin Gandapur criticising PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja added another dimension to the unfolding controversy.
In the said recording, Gandapur is said to have blamed Raja’s “mismanagement and flawed planning” for the provincial government’s dismissal and the party’s current predicament.
According to statements attributed to Gandapur, PTI was now bearing the consequences of Raja’s mistakes and poor planning. He further said the founding chairman had given Raja authority, but he had failed to use it effectively to deliver desired results.
The authenticity of the recording could not be independently verified by The Express Tribune .
He also expressed anger over Raja’s recent social media post, demanding that the party secretary general delete it, apologise and explain the allegations he had made.
Separately, in a social media post , the former chief minister lambasted Raja for his post on X, calling it “extremely regrettable, irresponsible, and damaging to the internal unity of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf”.
Earlier in the day, Raja had warned that PTI’s internal unity was allegedly being targeted by what he described as undemocratic decision-makers in a post on X.
“There is currently an attack by undemocratic decision-makers on the internal consensus within PTI. A narrative is being spread that 68 members of the K-P Assembly are set to announce the provincial president and the candidate for the next Chief Minister as a group without the permission of Imran Khan sahib and the party's Political Committee,” he stated on X.
Raja further asserted that the group had cut off contact with Afridi and his team during the final days of the crisis, paving the way for what he described as state coercion, an emergency and governor’s rule.
Read more: 'No link between K-P emergency, minerals'
He urged party workers and leaders not to believe any conspiracy narrative until an investigation had been completed.
Clarifying the provincial governance structure of the party, Raja said, “Junaid Akbar sahib remains the constitutionally appointed president of the party in K-P. His appointment was made personally by Imran Khan sahib. In his absence, the province's General Secretary Ali Asghar Khan sahib is the acting president.”
Raja also maintained that Afridi remained the chief minister under the Constitution and the law.
He ended his post with a strong warning against those allegedly spreading mistrust within the party.
Gandapur called on the PTI secretary general to give evidence to prove his claims.
“You have mentioned ‘undemocratic decision-makers’ and an alleged group's conspiracy. First, clarify who these people are. Which assembly members are being accused of wanting to decide on the provincial president or next chief minister without Imran Khan's and the political committee's permission? If you have evidence, bring the names forward,” he said, adding, “Similarly, on what basis is this serious allegation being made that a group cut off contact with Chief Minister Muhammad Sohail Afridi and his team to pave the way for emergency rule and governor's rule?”
He also said party members did not need loyalty certificates from anyone.
“Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa stood with Imran Khan, stands with him, and will continue to stand with him. For this loyalty, we do not need anyone's confirmation or permission.”
Barrister Gohar says party remains united
Amid the exchange of statements, PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan told The Express Tribune via telephone that he had directed party leaders to stop issuing statements against one another. He said he had spoken to Gandapur, Sheikh Waqas Akram, Ali Asghar Khan and Raja, adding that the party remained united.
Gohar maintained that PTI’s members of the provincial assembly were united and had neither violated party policy nor intended to do so in the future.
He said he was proud of the party’s elected representatives and that the founding chairman was proud of them as well. Reiterating the party’s position on the provincial leadership, Gohar said Afridi “was, is and will remain” the chief minister of K-P.

title: HSY issues urgent warning after phone and personal accounts compromised
description: The designer issued a statement after his phone  WhatsApp  email and contact list were compromised
content:
The designer issued a statement after his phone, WhatsApp, email and contact list were compromised
HSY has issued an urgent security warning after his phone and personal accounts were reportedly compromised on 20 October, prompting concerns over messages sent to hundreds of contacts.
In a statement shared on Instagram, HSY revealed that his phone, WhatsApp, email and contact list had been accessed, warning followers, friends and associates to remain vigilant over any suspicious communications appearing to come from him.
“Yesterday, 20 October, my phone, WhatsApp, email and contact list were compromised,” he wrote. “I do not know the extent of the messages that may have been sent, but hundreds of people have received messages from my accounts.”
The incident has raised concerns about the potential misuse of his personal accounts, with contacts urged to exercise caution and verify any unexpected requests before taking action.
HSY stressed that people should not respond to unusual messages, transfer money, share personal information, click on links or open attachments without first confirming their authenticity through a trusted contact number. He also warned against following instructions that appear to come from him without verifying them independently.
"Please do not respond to unusual messages, send money or personal information, click links, open attachments, or follow any instructions that appear to come from me without verifying them directly through a trusted number", he said.
Reassuring followers about his wellbeing, HSY said: “I’m okay, and we’re working to secure everything.”
He also apologised to those affected by the incident, acknowledging the concern and disruption the compromised accounts may have caused.
“I’m truly sorry for any worry, confusion or inconvenience this may have caused,” he added.
While the full extent of the breach remains unclear, the incident serves as a reminder of the risks associated with compromised phones and connected accounts. Access to messaging apps, email and contact lists can potentially be exploited to send fraudulent messages, impersonate account holders or solicit money and sensitive information from people they know.
For now, the priority is securing the affected accounts and preventing further misuse. HSY’s warning makes one point clear: any unusual request appearing to come from him should be verified directly before anyone takes action.

title: Haider Ali snares silver in Nagoya
description: Pakistan   s paralympic athlete finishes second in discus throw F37 category in Asian Para Games
content:
Pakistan’s Paralympic athlete finishes second in discus throw F37 category in Asian Para Games
Pakistan's premier athlete Haider Ali won silver in the men's F37 discus throw event at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya, Japan, on Wednesday, finishing behind Uzbekistan's Kudratillokhon Marufkhujaev in a closely contested final.
Ali, who won gold in the discus throw at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games, recorded a throw of 57.20 metres to secure second place in Nagoya.
His throws remained 51.63, 56.51, 54.98, 53.65, 57.20 and 54.45 metres.
“Thanks God I had worked hard and was rewarded,” Haider told The Express Tribune from Nagoya.
"I have trained for one year as it was a big event," Gujranwala-born Haider said.
Uzbekistan's Marufkhujaev took gold with 57.39 metres, setting an Asian Para Games record, while India's Haney claimed bronze with 57.04 metres. Both Ali and the Indian athlete recorded personal bests.
The margin between gold and silver was just 19 centimetres, while Haney finished a further 16 centimetres behind Ali.
Uzbekistan's Tolibboy Yuldashev ended fourth with 55.39 metres, followed by Japan's Yamato Shimbo with 51.31 metres. Uzbekistan's Asilbek Mukimov placed sixth with 49.90 metres, while Thailand's Thanaphon Kongsao finished seventh with 36.34 metres.
The world record of 59.75 metres in the F37 men's discus belongs to Uzbekistan's Khusniddin Norbekov, who set the mark at the Rio 2016 Paralympic Games.
Ali's silver added another podium finish to his decorated career in para athletics, as Pakistan secured a place among the medal winners in the event.
The 41-year-old has an illustrious career on the international stage. He won gold in the discus throw at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games, silver in the long jump at Beijing 2008 and bronze in the long jump at Rio 2016. He also secured bronze in the discus throw at the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Haider is also a four-time Asian Para Games gold medallist and has also won two bronze medals at the continental event.

title: Glee    reboot officially greenlit for Disney  and Hulu
description: Ryan Murphy has written a reboot script with Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan  but casting remains unconfirmed
content:
Ryan Murphy has written a reboot script with Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan, but casting remains unconfirmed
Glee is officially returning, with Disney+ and Hulu greenlighting a reboot of the hit musical comedy drama created by Ryan Murphy. The announcement marks a new chapter for the series, which became a cultural phenomenon during its original six season run.
The original Glee premiered on Fox in 2009 and concluded in 2015. Set initially at a high school in Lima, Ohio, it followed students in a show choir as they navigated friendships, relationships, personal struggles and their ambitions in music and performance.
The series earned a devoted following for its musical performances and its willingness to address subjects including sexuality, race, disability and mental health. Its covers of popular songs also became a defining feature, helping the show maintain an audience long after its finale.
Although the reboot has received the green light, details about its storyline and cast remain limited. Disney confirmed that 20th Television is producing the new series, which will be available on Hulu and Disney+.
Murphy recently revealed that he had written a reboot script with collaborators Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan. Speaking to Entertainment Tonight , he said he had contacted around 10 members of the original cast and described their responses as enthusiastic, although no returning actors have been officially confirmed.
Lea Michele has previously expressed interest in reprising her involvement, saying that the show and Murphy continue to hold a special place in her heart.
Chris Colfer, meanwhile, has acknowledged that revisiting the series would be complicated following the death of co-star Naya Rivera in 2020. He nevertheless recognised the strength of the show's fanbase and left open the possibility of considering a return.
The original ensemble also included Cory Monteith, Jane Lynch, Matthew Morrison, Amber Riley, Darren Criss and Kevin McHale.
For now, the reboot's release date, casting and creative direction have not been announced. Its confirmation nevertheless offers fans another opportunity to revisit the world of show choir, musical performances and teenage drama that defined Glee .

title: Sacha Baron Cohen defends Ali G return despite backlash over    problematic    humour
description: The actor argues prejudice and conspiracy theories have made his satirical characters relevant again in 2026
content:
The actor argues prejudice and conspiracy theories have made his satirical characters relevant again in 2026
Sacha Baron Cohen has defended his decision to revive Ali G, arguing that the controversial character’s outdated and problematic qualities make him relevant to the modern world. The comedian has brought his satirical alter ego back for Ali G: Who Iz I? , scheduled to arrive in cinemas on October 23, 2026.
In an essay for Time magazine, Baron Cohen explained that the character was created to expose prejudice, bias and ignorance rather than endorse them. He argued that the social problems his comedy once targeted have become increasingly visible, with social media and artificial intelligence helping spread misinformation and conspiracy theories.
“The fact that Ali G is outdated and problematic is the very reason I resurrected him,” he wrote.
Baron Cohen, 55, also reflected on how public attitudes have changed since Ali G first appeared on British television in 1998. The character later featured in Da Ali G Show and the 2002 film Ali G Indahouse .
The actor said that prejudiced views which once emerged gradually during conversations now appear increasingly mainstream. He believes his latest film aims to confront those attitudes through satire while making audiences laugh.
However, Ali G’s return has already attracted criticism. During the Los Angeles premiere of Ali G: Who Iz I? , Baron Cohen appeared in character and made a sexually suggestive remark about actress Sydney Sweeney while responding to a question about the Paramount and Warner Bros. merger.
The comment prompted criticism online, with some viewers questioning whether the character’s humour remains appropriate in 2026. Others have argued that Ali G’s approach has become dated and needs to address contemporary issues more effectively.
Baron Cohen maintains that the character is intended to mock the ignorant persona he portrays and the people who take him seriously.
His return therefore presents a familiar challenge for the comedian: convincing audiences that provocative humour can still expose prejudice without reinforcing the stereotypes it seeks to ridicule.

title: Aijaz Aslam shares thought provoking message on society normalising sin
description: The actor questioned society   s normalisation of sin while reflecting on the emotional finale of Pehli Baarish
content:
The actor questioned society’s normalisation of sin while reflecting on the emotional finale of Pehli Baarish
Pakistani actor Aijaz Aslam sparked reflection on social attitudes after sharing a message about how certain behaviours can become so common that people stop questioning their moral implications.
The actor took to Instagram to share a thought-provoking post highlighting everyday terms such as “Drink,” “Date,” “Chai Pani,” “Interest,” “Fashion” and “Friendship,” alongside Urdu references that question how society views such practices. The message suggests that when questionable behaviour becomes part of everyday culture, people may gradually stop recognising its significance.
Adding his approval to the post, Aijaz simply wrote, “So true,” agreeing with its central message.
The post encourages followers to look beyond familiar labels and consider whether the language used to describe everyday actions can make them appear more acceptable than they otherwise might. By drawing attention to common expressions, it invites audiences to reflect on personal choices, social influences and the values that shape their understanding of right and wrong.
Alongside his reflective post, Aijaz has also shared an emotional update about his professional journey, offering followers a glimpse into the closing moments of Pehlī Baarish .
In another Instagram post , the actor appeared alongside his co-star Faiza Hassan, with the two forming a heart shape with their hands. The picture accompanied a heartfelt caption as the project approached its finale.
“Final days… but the emotions hit harder than ever,” Aijaz wrote, capturing the bittersweet feeling of reaching the end of a creative journey.
Reflecting on the experience, he added, “From every intense twist to every soft moment, Pehli Baarish has been a journey straight from the heart.”
He also expressed gratitude for being part of a story filled with passion, powerful performances and what he described as “pure magic created by an incredible team.”
Looking ahead to the finale, the actor shared his hopes for the audience, writing, “As we move towards the finale, I hope this beautiful ride stayed with you just like it stayed with us.”
The message highlighted the emotional connection actors can develop with a project and the lasting memories created through collaboration, storytelling and shared experiences.
Aslam is a well-known Pakistani actor, model and fashion designer who has remained a familiar face in the country's entertainment industry for decades. He has earned recognition through his work in television dramas and sitcoms, building a career that extends beyond acting into fashion and other creative pursuits.
Through his social media presence, the actor shares glimpses of his professional commitments, behind-the-scenes moments and personal reflections with his followers.
His recent posts offer two distinct perspectives: one encouraging people to question behaviours that society may take for granted, and another celebrating the emotional bonds formed during a television production.

title: Greta Gerwig   s  Narnia  trailer surpasses  Barbie    Mario  and  Wonka  with 481m views
description: The figure more than doubles the 240m views recorded by Gerwig   s  Barbie  trailer in its first week
content:
The figure more than doubles the 240m views recorded by Gerwig’s 'Barbie' trailer in its first week
Greta Gerwig’s upcoming Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew has made a major impact before its theatrical debut, with the film’s first trailer attracting 481 million views in its first seven days, surpassing the initial-week viewership of Barbie, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie and Wonka.
According to data from WaveMetrix reported by Deadline, the trailer’s extraordinary view count puts it among the most-watched film trailers ever. The figure more than doubles the 240 million views recorded by Gerwig’s Barbie trailer in its first week. It also exceeds the 281.6 million views for The Super Mario Galaxy Movie and the 237.2 million views for Wonka over the same period.
The response signals considerable interest in Gerwig’s next project following the enormous success of Barbie, which grossed more than $1.4 billion worldwide. The filmmaker is now turning her attention to the fantasy world created by author C. S. Lewis, adapting one of the foundational stories of The Chronicles of Narnia for Netflix.
Titled Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew, the film adapts Lewis’s 1955 novel, which explores the origins of Narnia and the events that precede The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe. The story follows two children, Digory Kirke and Polly Plummer, who discover magical rings that transport them between worlds and eventually witness the creation of Narnia by the lion Aslan.
The trailer debuted on October 13 and features Led Zeppelin’s iconic song “Stairway to Heaven”, marking the first time the track has been licensed for a film trailer. Gerwig personally approached the band’s Jimmy Page and Robert Plant to secure permission, explaining that the song’s spiritual journey mirrored the themes of Lewis’s story.
The film stars newcomers David McKenna and Beatrice Campbell as Digory and Polly, alongside Daniel Craig, Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, Ciarán Hinds and Meryl Streep. Craig plays Uncle Andrew, while Mackey portrays Jadis, the character who eventually becomes the White Witch. Streep voices Aslan, whose creation of Narnia is central to the story.
Gerwig has spoken about her longstanding connection to the books, describing The Magician’s Nephew as a formative influence on her imagination. The director has also emphasised her desire to create a film designed for the big screen, with Netflix committing to a wide theatrical release rather than its traditional streaming-first approach.
The trailer’s popularity has also generated discussion among fans about Gerwig’s interpretation of the source material. A poll conducted by NarniaWeb across its social media platforms found that 46% of more than 4,000 respondents felt more optimistic about the film after watching the trailer, while 35% said they felt less optimistic. Despite the mixed reactions, 70% said they would definitely or probably watch it in cinemas.
The renewed attention has extended to Lewis’s original books, with The Magician’s Nephew climbing to No. 3 in Amazon’s Kindle Store Children’s Classics category following the trailer’s release. Other books in the series also experienced a boost, suggesting that the film’s marketing is introducing the franchise to new readers as well as reconnecting longtime fans with the fictional world.
Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew will receive IMAX previews on February 10, 2027, before opening in cinemas worldwide on February 12. The film is scheduled to arrive on Netflix on April 2, 2027, following an exclusive theatrical window.
With its first trailer already outperforming the early viewership of several major blockbusters, Gerwig’s adaptation is generating substantial anticipation ahead of its release. Whether that online interest translates into comparable box office success remains to be seen, but the film has already established itself as one of Netflix’s most closely watched upcoming releases.

title: Alexander Skarsg  rd wears Olivia Colman   s face on shirt at  Wicker  premiere
description: Alexander Skarsg  rd pays tribute to co star Olivia Colman with statement shirt at  Wicker  premiere in Los Angeles
content:
Alexander Skarsgård pays tribute to co-star Olivia Colman with statement shirt at 'Wicker' premiere in Los Angeles
Alexander Skarsgård wore a shirt featuring Olivia Colman’s face to the Los Angeles premiere of their upcoming film Wicker on Tuesday, October 20.
The Swedish actor paired the unusual design with a plaid skirt, drawing attention to his fashion choices on the red carpet.
Skarsgård, 50, wore a fitted, long-sleeved black shirt featuring a framed image of Colman surrounded by button detailing.
He completed the outfit with a punk-inspired plaid skirt from Chopova Lowena, split between black-and-yellow and pink-and-black patterns, with safety-pin-style details at the waist. Black dress shoes and matching socks completed the look.
The actor posed for photographs alongside Colman, 52, and fellow cast member Elizabeth Debicki. His brother, Bill Skarsgård, later joined them.
The red-carpet appearance comes ahead of Wicker’s cinema release on Friday, October 23. Based on Ursula Wills’ short story The Wicker Husband, the film is set in a fantastical medieval European village.
Colman plays an unconventional fisherwoman who commissions a local basket weaver, portrayed by Peter Dinklage, to create her ideal husband. When the wicker husband, played by Skarsgård, arrives, the pair develop a romantic relationship that causes disruption within the village.
Speaking at the film’s premiere at the Sundance Film Festival in January, Skarsgård discussed the challenge of playing a character unlike those he typically portrays.
“I was quite intimidated when I read [the script] because I tend to be drawn toward more conflicted characters with more internal turmoil and darkness,” the actor said.
"To play this good-hearted, good-natured, sweet, morally righteous character was scary to me," he added. "I'm not really comfortable doing that. I don't have anything to tap into when it comes to that. So it was a stretch as an actor."
Colman previously described the screenplay as one of her "top three favorite scripts I've ever read" in a January interview with Deadline .

title: Law Roach explains why Keke Palmer ended their styling partnership

content:
Law Roach shares his side of story behind Keke Palmer’s decision to end their styling partnership
Law Roach has explained why Keke Palmer ended their professional styling relationship, revealing that disagreements over how to dress the actor during her pregnancy contributed to the difficulties.
Roach, known for styling Zendaya, said Palmer’s decision to keep her pregnancy private affected the outfits he could create for her.
He explained that he wanted to embrace her baby bump through fashion, while Palmer preferred clothing that concealed it until she was ready to announce the news publicly.
Reflecting on their split, Roach described the decision as a professional one and acknowledged that he had struggled to deliver the looks Palmer wanted.
“It was a business decision that she should have made, i couldn’t get the looks right, i couldn’t get the energy right and it was like she made a business decision to fire me,” he said.
Roach also recalled a conversation in which Palmer explained why she felt the partnership was no longer working.
“I love what she said, she called me she said ‘you may be the best artist in the world but you are not the best stylist for me’,” he added.
According to Roach, Palmer’s wish to keep her pregnancy private created a creative difference between them. While he was excited about the possibility of styling maternity looks and developing fashion concepts around her changing silhouette, she did not want her pregnancy revealed before she chose to share the news.
“She was pregnant and she was lying about being pregnant and this lady had me putting her in all these clothes hiding this baby bump,” Roach said, explaining that he wanted to style the bump rather than conceal it.
He acknowledged, however, that the decision about when to announce the pregnancy belonged to Palmer.

The original release supported local cooperative play for up to four players, allowing friends to play together on the same system.
The remastered edition introduces several upgrades designed for modern hardware. These include improved textures, an enhanced user interface, upgraded cutscenes and support for 4K resolution.
Players will also have access to a new Photo Mode and a Cheat Mode, offering additional ways to customise their experience.
One of the most notable additions is online co-op. While the original game limited cooperative play to local multiplayer, the remaster will allow up to four players to team up online.

title: Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsg  rd   s    Wicker    earns 93  on Rotten Tomatoes ahead of release
description: Peter Dinklage plays basket maker who creates unusual husband for ostracised fisherwoman in fantasy romance
content:
Peter Dinklage plays basket maker who creates unusual husband for ostracised fisherwoman in fantasy romance
Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård’s upcoming fantasy romance Wicker has received an encouraging response from film critics, earning a 93% score on Rotten Tomatoes from 43 reviews as of October 20, 2026.
Directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson, the R rated film adapts Ursula Wills’ short story The Wicker Husband . Its unusual premise centres on an ostracised fisherwoman, played by Colman, who asks her village’s basket maker, portrayed by Peter Dinklage, to create a husband from wicker.
Skarsgård plays the resulting creation, whose relationship with the fisherwoman brings unexpected happiness before jealousy among the villagers threatens their life together. The supporting cast includes Elizabeth Debicki, Marli Siu, Nabhaan Rizwan and Richard E Grant.
The early reviews suggest that the film’s distinctive premise and performances have impressed many critics, although its mixture of romance, dark fantasy and bawdy humour has not worked for everyone.
Richard Lawson of The Hollywood Reporter praised the film’s personality and humane outlook, while Robert Daniels of RogerEbert.com highlighted the filmmakers’ ability to make its fantastical events feel emotionally convincing.
Johnny Oleksinski of the New York Post also responded positively, praising Colman’s uninhibited performance and the shift towards more serious emotions as the story develops.
Ryan Lattanzio of IndieWire acknowledged concerns about extending a short story into a feature but ultimately gave the film a positive assessment, pointing to the cast’s distinctive performances.
However, the response has not been unanimous. Robbie Collin of The Daily Telegraph criticised aspects of the film, while Benjamin Lee of The Guardian questioned its tonal consistency, particularly its combination of bawdy comedy, dark fantasy and romance.
The 93% score reflects the reviews available at the time and could change as further critics assess the film. Rotten Tomatoes’ critics’ consensus had not yet been published.
Wicker is scheduled to hold preview screenings on Thursday, October 22, ahead of its nationwide US theatrical release on Friday, October 23, 2026.

title: Michael Sheen reveals on    Celebrity Traitors    that he has given away    pretty much all    of his money
description: The Welsh actor says becoming a parent has changed his outlook on life and helped him leave insecurity behind
content:
The Welsh actor says becoming a parent has changed his outlook on life and helped him leave insecurity behind
Michael Sheen has revealed that he has given away “pretty much all” of the money he has earned throughout his acting career, explaining that his attitude towards wealth has remained largely unchanged since he was 18.
The Welsh actor, 57, shared the revelation in an interview with Saga magazine, reflecting on how his priorities have developed over the years. Sheen said he had never been particularly concerned about accumulating money, even as his professional success grew.
“At 18, I did not care whether I had money or not,” he explained, adding that although he was not living in poverty, he learned to make do with what he had.
Sheen said he had been fortunate enough to earn substantial sums through acting but had ultimately given most of that money away, whether deliberately or by circumstance. He also stressed that material possessions remain unimportant to him, although he wants to ensure his family has financial security and a home.
The actor has previously described himself as a not-for-profit performer. In 2019, he helped finance the Homeless World Cup in Cardiff after the event faced a funding crisis, selling properties to cover the costs. He also used £100,000 of his own money to anonymously clear strangers’ debts.
Beyond his approach to money, Sheen discussed how becoming a father has changed his perspective. He shares daughter Lily Mo Sheen, 27, with former partner Kate Beckinsale, and has two younger daughters, Lyra and Mabli, with his partner Anna Lundberg.
Sheen said parenthood had fundamentally changed his experience of life, despite the difficulties and mistakes that came with it.
He also reflected on retaining his ambition while becoming less insecure with age. As a young actor, he worried that growing older might mean losing his desire to change the world. He now believes those ambitions can remain strong without the insecurities that sometimes affect how people treat others.
Sheen is currently appearing on Celebrity Traitors and continues to work across television and theatre. His reflections suggest that success, for him, is measured less by personal wealth than by family, purpose and the ability to help others.

content:
Dykes began his 434-mile journey down the Sangha River on October 8 as part of his Project Six challenge
Welsh adventurer and TikTok explorer Ash Dykes has reportedly been out of contact for more than 16 hours during his expedition through the Congo Basin, prompting concern from his team as he navigates a remote stretch of the Sangha River.
Dykes’ team shared an update on Instagram and TikTok on Wednesday,October 21, 2026, revealing that they had not heard from the explorer or his crew for more than 16 hours.
“It’s been more than 16 hours since we last heard from Ash and the team which is concerning,” the statement read. “We will endeavour to keep you posted and let you all know as soon as we hear more. Thank you.”
The team has not confirmed the reason for the communication blackout or whether the group is facing an emergency. The lack of contact does not, by itself, confirm that Dykes or his companions are missing or in immediate danger.
Dykes began his 434-mile journey down the Sangha River on October 8 as part of his Project Six challenge.
He is travelling through the remote Central African rainforest in an inflatable kayak, accompanied by a local guide and a videographer. The expedition is expected to take three to four weeks.
The journey presents several challenges, including crocodiles, hippos, tropical diseases and difficult river conditions.
Dykes has also documented setbacks during the trip, including a painful sting from an unidentified insect.
His team previously indicated that satellite communications would be used to share updates from the rainforest, although connectivity can be limited in remote areas.
The expedition team has pledged to provide further information when contact is restored. No additional details about their whereabouts were included in the latest statement.

title: Russia says it will send first diesel cargo to US on Thursday
description: Deputy Prime Minister Novak reveals vessel carries 40 000 metric tons of fuel  paperwork on supply nearing completion
content:
Deputy Prime Minister Novak reveals vessel carries 40,000 metric tons of fuel, paperwork on supply nearing completion
Russia will dispatch its first tanker with diesel for the United States on Thursday, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said, according to the Vedomosti news outlet, after a deal with US President Donald Trump.
Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on October 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries , after reaching the deal with Trump to supply diesel to global markets.
Novak said on Wednesday the vessel will carry 40,000 metric tons of the fuel, adding that the paperwork on the fuel supply is nearing its completion, according to media reports. He did not name the port from which the cargo will be delivered.
"Additional shipments will follow, of course. There were agreements reached between the two leaders. We will meet the United States' needs, to the extent of our capabilities," RIA news agency quoted Novak as saying.
Read: Trump holds off on new measures against Russia to avoid undermining Ukraine peace talks
Trump has said Russia would immediately export 300,000 metric tons, or 2.25 million barrels, followed by 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter". The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day.
Russian President Vladimir Putin was hosting US special envoy Steve Witkoff on Wednesday, after the US-Russia diesel export deal led to a sharp deterioration in ties between the US and Ukraine.
During the talks in St Petersburg, Witkoff thanked Putin for lifting the export restrictions. Putin also mentioned the deal, saying that global diesel prices dropped by 5%-6% after the agreement. "That's an example of us working together, I want to thank you for that," Witkoff said in televised comments.
Putin also said that first Russian tankers with diesel will departs in two to three days. "We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now. They will go one after another. The financial component should be provided," he said, adding that Russia also would be able to supply fertilisers in "large quantities" to the US market.

title: Smash Bros  director warns AI could threaten originality in gaming industry
description: Masahiro Sakurai warns that AI could flood Steam with derivative games and make original titles harder to discover
content:
Masahiro Sakurai warns that AI could flood Steam with derivative games and make original titles harder to discover
Masahiro Sakurai, the creator of Super Smash Bros. and Kirby, has warned that the growing use of artificial intelligence (AI) could lead to more derivative games and make original titles increasingly difficult to discover.
In a recent interview with Denfaminicogamer , Sakurai discussed the challenges of developing original ideas and communicating their appeal to publishers and development teams.
He explained that originality requires more than improving existing concepts, as designers must create experiences that audiences do not already know they want.
“Nowadays, so many games are described as XX-like, or games that resemble another one. In other words, the thing everyone else already wants. But originality means you have to create something that isn’t already what people are after, and be deliberate with that. It’s a high hurdle.”
Sakurai previously helped oversee the Game Designers Award at the Tokyo Game Show for 16 years, recognising games with innovative designs. He announced the award’s end after being unable to find a suitable successor.
He also highlighted the growth of Steam releases since the award was established in 2010. According to Sakurai, approximately 275 games launched on the platform annually at the time, compared with more than 19,000 today. Steam Next Fest also features thousands of game demos.
Sakurai believes AI could accelerate this growth, potentially filling the market with games that imitate existing concepts rather than introduce new ideas.
“Although 19,000 titles is a lot, I think that number will only grow from now on, because AI will be used to turn them out. Most of them will end up unplayable, and there will be so many that it’ll be impossible to keep track or even understand them.”
He cited the proliferation of puzzle games inspired by simple mechanics as an example of imitation already occurring in the industry.
Sakurai acknowledged that AI could reproduce the atmosphere of games by developers such as Fumito Ueda, but argued that it would not be able to create whatever Ueda himself produces in the future.

Dillon explained that acting work 'has all but diminished' after 11 years working in theatre, film and television
Actor Asia Kate Dillon, known for roles in Billions , Orange Is the New Black and John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, has announced they are seeking customer service work after a decline in acting opportunities.
In a statement shared on social media on Tuesday, Dillon explained that their acting work “has all but diminished” after 11 years working exclusively in theatre, film and television.
The actor, who uses they/them pronouns, said they first entered the service industry at the age of 15, working at Ithaca Bakery in New York. Their previous roles included dishwasher, food runner and floor manager.
“I continued working in food and general customer service, alongside any acting gigs I could rustle up, until the fall of 2015 when I was finally able to make the transition to a full time income stemming from just my acting work,” Dillon wrote.
They added that the current situation reflects wider challenges facing performers, particularly those who are transgender, non-binary or gender non-conforming.
“Now, like for many, many performer colleagues of mine — particularly those of us who are trans/nonbinary/gender nonconforming — acting work has all but diminished, and I’m in need of service work once more,” they said.
Dillon played Taylor Mason across six seasons of Billions , appearing in 71 episodes, and portrayed Brandy Epps in Orange Is the New Black . Their film credits also include the John Wick franchise.
Despite returning to the job market, Dillon expressed enthusiasm for customer service, highlighting their passion for food, drink and creating welcoming environments.
They said they are available for part-time, evening and weekend work, adding that they are a quick learner who can adapt to new payment systems.

title: Paul Mescal  Daisy Edgar Jones and Jessie Buckley back Sally Rooney in open letter
description: The letter comes after Rooney s publisher stopped supplying her books in the UK over her support for Palestine Action
content:
The letter comes after Rooney's publisher stopped supplying her books in the UK over her support for Palestine Action
Paul Mescal, Daisy Edgar-Jones and a host of prominent writers, actors and cultural figures have signed an open letter supporting Irish author Sally Rooney after her books were withdrawn from UK distribution over her support for Palestine Action.
The letter, published by New Statesman on October 21, declares, “Sally Rooney is a writer, not a terrorist. Her books must be available to the public.” It argues that the withdrawal of Rooney’s work represents an attack on freedom of expression and calls on the British government to amend the anti-terrorism legislation behind the decision.
Mescal and Edgar-Jones starred as Connell Waldron and Marianne Sheridan in the acclaimed television adaptation of Rooney’s novel Normal People, while director Lenny Abrahamson, who helmed six of the series’ 12 episodes, has also signed the letter.
Other high-profile signatories include actors Tilda Swinton and Susan Sarandon, singer-songwriter CMAT, actress Jessie Buckley, musician Robert Del Naja of Massive Attack, filmmaker Jonathan Glazer and former footballer Gary Lineker. Authors Zadie Smith, Arundhati Roy, Julian Barnes, Jeanette Winterson, Irvine Welsh and Marian Keyes have also added their names. Nobel literature laureates Anne Carson, Annie Ernaux and JM Coetzee are among the supporters.
The letter comes after Rooney’s publisher, Faber, announced last week that it would stop supplying her books in the UK, with the author’s agreement. The decision followed concerns that UK earnings from her work could be passed on to support Palestine Action, which the British government proscribed as a terrorist organisation in July 2025.
Rooney has publicly expressed her support for the direct-action group and previously said she intended to use proceeds from her books and television adaptations to support it. Under UK law, providing money or other property to a proscribed organisation can constitute a criminal offence in certain circumstances.
Faber said existing legislation meant it could no longer pass UK earnings to Rooney, describing the prospect of selling her books without paying her as “unconscionable”. The publisher said it would continue selling her work in other territories.
Rooney’s books have not been formally banned in the UK. Bookshops can continue selling copies already in stock, but retailers can no longer order new supplies from Faber. The distinction has become central to the debate over whether the decision amounts to indirect censorship.
The signatories argue that the withdrawal of Rooney’s work undermines fundamental principles of free speech and artistic expression. They are urging the British government to change the legislation that has placed the author and her publisher in this position.
The controversy has also drawn attention to the wider consequences of the UK’s proscription of Palestine Action. The group, known for direct-action protests targeting companies linked to the arms industry, was banned following an incident in which activists broke into an RAF base and damaged aircraft in protest against British military support for Israel.
The legality of the proscription remains contested, with a further legal challenge expected to reach the UK Supreme Court. Critics of the ban argue that its application risks restricting peaceful political expression, while supporters of the legislation maintain that it is intended to prevent support for a prohibited organisation.
The open letter adds to growing opposition from cultural figures who believe the law should be reconsidered. For Rooney, the dispute has become a high-profile example of the tension between political convictions, publishing rights and the limits imposed by counterterrorism legislation.
With Mescal, Edgar-Jones and other prominent figures lending their support, the campaign is now drawing attention well beyond the literary world, placing freedom of expression and solidarity with Palestine at the centre of a widening public debate.

title: Pakistan sweep Bahrain in Billie Jean King Cup
description: Ushna Suhail and Mahin Aftab Qureshi lead the hosts to victory
content:
Ushna Suhail and Mahin Aftab Qureshi lead the hosts to victory
Pakistan opened their Billie Jean King Cup Asia/Oceania Group III (B) campaign with a 3-0 victory over Bahrain on Wednesday, marking the country’s first time hosting the international women’s team tennis competition.
Ushna Suhail and Mahin Aftab Qureshi secured commanding singles victories before teaming up to complete the clean sweep in the Group A tie at the Pakistan Tennis Federation Tennis Complex.
Suhail defeated Hajar Zaidan 6-0, 6-0, while Qureshi beat Gharam Alkhayat by the same scoreline.
The pair then joined forces in the doubles, defeating Eman Alzaimoor and Zaidan 6-1, 6-0 to seal Pakistan’s opening-day win.
Pakistan Tennis Federation president Aisam-ul-Haq Qureshi and secretary-general Colonel Zia-ud-Din Tufail praised the players for their performances and expressed confidence in the team’s prospects in the competition.
Eight nations are competing in the tournament, divided into two groups.
The Maldives also began their campaign with a 3-0 win over Bhutan. Keyara Usama Ali defeated Tandin Tsheyang Wangmo 6-1, 6-0, while Aishath Karin Saizan beat Tenzin Wangsel Lhaden 6-0, 6-1. The Maldivian pair then overcame Tandin Dorji and Kinley Yangden 6-1, 6-0 in the doubles.
Iran defeated Kuwait 3-0, with Hana Soltani beating Huda Aldabbous 6-2, 6-0 and Kimia Sagheb Tehrani defeating Sumou Aldabbous 6-0, 6-0. Meshkatolzahra Safi and Yasaman Yazdani completed the sweep with a 6-0, 6-2 doubles victory over the Aldabbous sisters.
Jordan edged Qatar 2-1 in the other tie. Ana Abualhaj recovered from a set down to defeat Dana Khalifa 5-7, 6-4, 6-0, while Noor Sayej beat Mubaraka Al Naimi 7-5, 6-0 to secure the tie for Jordan.
Qatar claimed the doubles, with Hinda Al Mudahka and Khadija Gassama defeating Abualhaj and Sayej 6-3, 6-4.

Dwayne Johnson has surprised fans with a dramatic new look on the set of Lizard Music , appearing almost unrecognisable as an elderly man in the upcoming fantasy adventure directed by Benny Safdie.
Photographs taken during filming in Brooklyn, New York, on October 20 show the actor wearing a grey wig, facial hair, ageing prosthetics, a beige overcoat and a matching bucket hat. The transformation marks another major change in appearance for Johnson, who recently worked with Safdie on the 2025 sports drama The Smashing Machine .
In Lizard Music , Johnson plays Chicken Man, an eccentric character in his seventies. The film adapts Daniel Pinkwater’s children’s book of the same name and follows a young boy, played by Theo Clark Leber, who discovers a mysterious late night television broadcast featuring musical lizards.
His search for answers leads him to Chicken Man and the older man’s beloved chicken, Claudia. Their unlikely friendship takes them into a strange world filled with unexpected discoveries.
The film’s cast also includes Rachel McAdams, Colman Domingo, Jeff Goldblum, Alicia Silverstone, Regina Hall and David Krumholtz.
According to Variety , the team responsible for Johnson’s ageing appearance includes acclaimed makeup artist Kazu Hiro, known for his transformative work in films such as Darkest Hour and Oppenheimer .
Johnson has also discussed changing his physique for the role. During a career retrospective at the 2025 Toronto International Film Festival, he revealed that he had shed around 30 pounds of muscle to help portray Chicken Man.
The actor previously underwent a substantial physical transformation to play mixed martial arts fighter Mark Kerr in The Smashing Machine , making his latest role another departure from his familiar action hero image.
Amazon MGM Studios has scheduled Lizard Music for a US theatrical release on December 25, 2027. The film reunites Johnson and Safdie for a project that combines fantasy, comedy and an unusual coming of age adventure.

title: French government faces fresh test as Yellow Vests mobilise
description: Yellow Vest activists seek to revive their campaign against rising living costs  declining public services
content:
Yellow Vest activists seek to revive their campaign against rising living costs, declining public services
France's Yellow Vest movement filed plans for a major ​march through Paris on Saturday, presenting the government with its next major test after riots and looting last weekend shook confidence ‌in its ability to maintain order.
Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu was due to meet union leaders on Wednesday, seeking ways to defuse one of the worst crises France has faced in recent years and avoid a repeat of the violence that swept French cities on October 17.
A representative of the "Gilets Jaunes" (Yellow Vests) movement, which is a grassroots ​group not tied to the unions, presented plans for a march across the heart of Paris, including areas that were ransacked just ​days ago.
Student groups have also called for protests the same day to push their demands for more investment ⁠in education. Yellow Vest activists are seeking to revive their campaign, which emerged in 2018, against rising living costs and declining public services.
Investors fret, French borrowing costs climb
Last weekend's demonstrations rapidly degenerated into rampant violence, especially in Paris, Marseille, Lyon and Limoges, which overwhelmed police and took hours to contain.
Highlighting ​investor concern over the situation, French government borrowing costs have risen sharply this week, pushing benchmark 10-year bond yields to 5%, their highest level since July 2002.
Analysts said markets are worried that the unrest could complicate government efforts to repair strained public finances at a time of already mounting budget pressures.
French President Emmanuel Macron said he would meet ​intelligence services on Thursday ahead of the new protests.
Read: French PM calls for 'partial curfews' in cities hit by riots and looting
Government ministers have promised a vastly reinforced security operation after acknowledging shortcomings in their initial response, ​with troops expected to be deployed alongside additional police.
In a letter to unions ahead of Wednesday's meeting, Lecornu said their talks should focus on ensuring "the indispensable ‌freedom to ⁠demonstrate", which he said some were trying to curtail by associating it with "unacceptable acts".
France's main unions have separately called a nationwide mobilisation for November 5.
"There is huge and legitimate anger, and the answer to that situation is not repression. It is a political response. That's what I will tell the prime minister today," Sophie Binet, head of the CGT union, told RTL radio.
Political backlash as government struggles
A second consecutive night of local curfews passed ​without major incidents in areas hit ​by the unrest, offering the ⁠government some respite as it prepared for fresh demonstrations.
The unrest has triggered a political backlash ahead of presidential elections next year, with candidates from the far right and hard left performing strongly in polls.
"The government has lost ​control of everything," far-right leader Marine Le Pen told Franceinfo radio.
Read more: Mass protests in France spiral into worst riots in years
The hard-left France Unbowed (LFI), which has been ​accused by ministers of ⁠fueling the unrest, criticised plans to deploy troops onto the streets of Paris.
"Demonstrators are not enemies within. The French government must not go to war against its own people," LFI's parliamentary group said in a statement.
Protests in other European countries, including Italy and Albania, have added to concerns that anger over living standards ⁠risks spreading ​around the continent at a time when many nations, including France, are struggling with ​budget woes.
Italy approved a raft of security measures on Tuesday, including a new offence of violent participation in a demonstration and tougher penalties for rioters in response to the turbulence ​last weekend.
